title: 第11章 坊市第12章 大意
slug: 凡人修仙开局看守草药场
content_zh:
处理掉二人的尸体，留下两个储物袋。
这炼气三层的大哥，就是不一样，光丹药就五瓶，炼气丹足足有三十枚，两颗筑基丹，竟然还有五枚聚灵丹。
这聚灵丹是筑基期修士才能服用的丹药，功效其实与炼气丹一样，只是效果增强了无数倍，同时单独以及副作用也一样，所以炼气期修士服用，结果只有暴毙。
除了丹药外，还有三张符箓分别是：
遁地符。
引灵符。
雷暴符。
看名字就已经清楚它们各自的作用了，但具体怎么用，苏星河倒是不清楚，保险起见，再次翻开《基础杂项》，一通研究。
入门一旬，没拜师，也没人指点修为，反倒是这一本书，成了自己名副其实的老师，下次再见采薇师姐，一定得好好感谢一下。
怎么感谢？
要不以身相许？
苏星河摸了摸自己刚刚开始冒头的胡渣，还是算了，哥还是个翩翩少年郎呢！
“月黑风高杀人夜，......”
躺在两条木板搭起的硬板床上，苏星河想吟诗一首，可是文思如尿崩，说断就断了。
光阴如梭，岁月如剑，转眼就是一年。
看守草药场，再没有任何风波，如果硬要说有，那就是年终的草药盘点，两位外门执事，看着明显挨了一坨，瘦了两圈的草药垛，陷入了沉思。
如果说是被盗了，但谁闲着没事偷这些低阶草药做什么，炼丹作用不大，又没什么灵气。
若是说被苏星河私藏，就更不可能了，一个炼气二层的废柴，储物袋是宗门统一发放的最基础的低阶储物袋，丈许方圆的空间，塞满了也就一箩筐而已。
难不成当饭吃了？
最后也不了了之，不过，临走时，将草药重新分类摆放，仔细清点了重量以及相对尺寸，如此苏星河便再不能肆无忌惮往灵净瓶里塞了。

断了这最后一点灵气来源，苏星河的修炼进展更为缓慢了。
每个月的十枚炼气丹都用不了，只因他灵根资质实在太差，五行杂灵根，无论是吸收，还是排出丹毒，都如蚂蚁，让他焦虑不已。
“有没有可能，把这丹药炼化，再次提纯，将单毒和杂质都排出去？”
苏星河想着，丢入一颗到灵净瓶。
半晌，丹药化为灰烬，一丝丝，几乎肉眼不可见的白雾产生。
好像有效果。
苏星河探指入内。
熟悉的感觉涌入身体，还没等一周天运转结束，灵力消融在经脉窍穴。
“好像不太行，虽然可以提炼出一丝灵力，但损失太多严重，只能留下十之一二的灵力。”
怪不得一箩筐一箩筐的草药塞进灵净瓶，最后只有一丝的灵力，原来这家伙就是个败家子，苏星河决定，以后就算吸收炼气丹再缓慢，也不用这玩意儿了，简直就是个貔貅。
“这个混沌神鼎，不用起来真是浪费了。”
随手又掏出混沌神鼎，反复把玩，立耳，大肚子，三足，怎么看都有点像茶壶，再说在，这也太袖珍了。
苏星河左右手互扔，在空中抛来抛去。
《基础杂项》中有提到炼丹，介绍了相关丹炉的品级，以及炼化不同丹药对应的不同鼎炉，就是没细说怎么使用。
苏星河尝试，再丢一颗炼气丹到鼎炉中，小心翼翼催动灵力，运转鼎炉。
神鼎古朴的篆文忽闪。
“啪嗒！”
随着一声清脆的炸裂。
苏星河连忙探头查看，果不其然，丹药直接碎成渣，乌黑一片。
“唉！还不如喂给灵净瓶，虽然它是个貔貅，起码还能吐出一丝灵气！”苏星河为自己的冲动，懊恼不已，虽然从马跃那打劫到一堆丹药后，自己已经不缺丹药了，况且自己这缓慢的炼化速度，即使每月十枚，都能剩下一半。

“得想个办法，去学习下炼丹，一件仙器炉鼎就这么闲置，有点可惜，更何况，既然是极品仙器，或许真能再一次将丹药提纯，若真是如此，修炼起来，可就不只是事半功倍了，而是十倍，二十倍！”
“去找虎子？他拜入峰主门下，资源一定是不缺的。”
content_en:
Dispose of the two bodies, leaving two storage bags.
This big brother at the third level of Qi Refining is just different. He only has five bottles of elixirs, thirty Qi Refining Pills, two Foundation Establishment Pills, and five Spirit Gathering Pills.
This spirit-gathering pill is a pill that can only be taken by monks in the foundation-building stage. Its effect is actually the same as that of the Qi-Refining Pill, but the effect is enhanced countless times. At the same time, the individual effects and side effects are the same. Therefore, if monks in the Qi-Refining stage take it, they will only die violently.
In addition to the elixir, there are three talismans:
Escape Talisman.
Spirit-attracting talisman.
Thunderstorm Talisman.
Just by looking at their names, they already knew their respective functions, but Su Xinghe didn't know exactly how to use them. To be on the safe side, he opened "Basic Miscellaneous" again and studied them.
Ten days into my career, I didn’t have a teacher, and no one to guide my cultivation. Instead, this book became my true teacher. Next time I see Senior Sister Caiwei, I must express my gratitude.
How to thank?
Why don't you pledge yourself to me?
Su Xinghe touched the stubble that had just begun to appear on his head and thought, forget it, I am still a handsome young man!
"The moon is dark and the wind is high, and the murderous night is..."
Lying on the hard bed made of two wooden boards, Su Xinghe wanted to recite a poem, but his thoughts were like diarrhea and he stopped as soon as he started.
Time flies like a shuttle, years are like swords, and one year passes in the blink of an eye.
There was no more trouble in guarding the herb farm. If there was one, it was the year-end herb inventory. The two outer deacons looked at the herb pile that had obviously suffered a mess and lost two laps, and fell into deep thought.
If it was stolen, who would steal these low-level herbs when they are free? The alchemy effect is not very good, and there is no aura.
It would be even more impossible to say that it was hidden by Su Xinghe, a waste of the second level of Qi Refining. The storage bag is the most basic low-level storage bag uniformly issued by the sect. It can only fill up a dozen of square meters of space.
Could it be eaten as a meal?
In the end, it was nothing, but before leaving, he re-categorized the herbs and carefully checked the weight and relative size, so that Su Xinghe could no longer stuff the Lingjing bottle unscrupulously.
With this last source of spiritual energy cut off, Su Xinghe's cultivation progress became even slower.
He couldn't use the ten Qi Refining Pills every month because his spiritual root qualifications were so poor. The five elements and mixed spiritual roots were like ants in absorbing and expelling erysipelas, which made him anxious.
"Is it possible to refine this elixir and purify it again to remove all single poisons and impurities?"
Su Xinghe thought about it and threw one into the Lingjing Bottle.
After a while, the elixir turned into ashes, and a trace of white mist, almost invisible to the naked eye, was produced.
It seems to be working.
Su Xinghe pointed inside.
A familiar feeling flooded into the body, and before the cycle was over, the spiritual power melted into the meridians and acupoints.
"It doesn't seem to work. Although it is possible to extract a little spiritual power, the loss is too serious and only one-tenth of the spiritual power can be left."
No wonder basket after basket of herbs were stuffed into the Ling Jing Bottle, and in the end there was only a trace of spiritual power. It turned out that this guy was a prodigal. Su Xinghe decided that no matter how slowly he absorbed the Qi Refining Pill in the future, he would not use this thing anymore. He was simply a fool.
"This Chaos Cauldron is really a waste if it is not used."
He took out the Cauldron of Chaos and played with it repeatedly. It had erect ears, a big belly, and three legs. It looked a bit like a teapot. Besides, it was too compact.
Su Xinghe threw his left and right hands at each other, tossing them back and forth in the air.
"Basic Miscellaneous" mentions alchemy, introduces the grades of the relevant elixir furnaces, and the different cauldrons corresponding to the refining of different elixirs, but does not explain in detail how to use them.
Su Xinghe tried, throwing another Qi Refining Pill into the cauldron, and carefully activated his spiritual power to run the cauldron.
The ancient seal script on the divine tripod flickered.
"Crack!"
With a crisp explosion.
Su Xinghe quickly put his head to check, and sure enough, the elixir was broken into pieces, completely black.
"well! It's better to feed it to the Lingjing Bottle. Even though it's a Pixiu, at least it can spit out a trace of spiritual energy! "Su Xinghe was very upset about his impulsiveness. Although after robbing a bunch of pills from Ma Yue, he had no shortage of pills. Moreover, with his slow refining speed, even if he had ten pills per month, half of them would be left.
"I have to think of a way to learn how to make alchemy. It's a pity that an immortal artifact, the furnace cauldron, is just idle like this. What's more, since it is a top-quality immortal artifact, it may be possible to purify the elixir again. If this is the case, the practice will not only get twice the result with half the effort, but ten times or twenty times! "
"Going to find Hu Zi? As he became the disciple of the peak master, there must be no shortage of resources. "
